responsibility: Provides rustc’s privacy analysis and enforcement passes. The crate’s root implementation in `lib.rs` computes effective visibilities, traverses HIR and type information to discover referenced definitions, checks module, name, and type privacy as well as private-in-public interface violations, emits the corresponding privacy diagnostics and lints, and exposes this functionality to the compiler by registering its queries through `provide`. Its `errors.rs` module supports that role by defining the structured diagnostics and lint messages used for private field and item access errors, effective-visibility reporting, and other privacy-related violations detected by the analysis.
